name: codex-advisor
description: A configurable strategic Advisor built on Codex subagents.

interface.shortDescription: Configure ordered Advisor subagents with retries.
interface.longDescription: Reads local Codex model catalogs or accepts manually entered models. Configure an ordered Advisor chain with per-model reasoning and retries for the current Codex subagent interface.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $advisor to open settings or request a strategic second opinion.
